subject: microbiology
title: Francisella tularensis, Pasteurella multocida and Bartonella

steps.tx: **Francisella tularensis** is a minute aerobic gram negative coccobacillus, cysteine demanding (cysteine heart and chocolate media), causing tularaemia: ulceroglandular (tick, hare handling), oculoglandular, pneumonic (aerosol and farming) and typhoidal forms, among the lowest infectious doses known and a classic laboratory acquired infection warning. Lymph nodes may remain enlarged for months, so persistence alone does not prove antibiotic failure.
steps.say: A rabbit, a tick, an ulcer and nodes: tularaemia; tell the laboratory before culturing.

right.title: Organism facts
points: Grows cysteine enriched, slow tiny colonies
Two subspecies: tularensis (A, virulent America), holarctica (B)
Serology and PCR diagnosis usual (culture hazard)

steps.tx: **Tularaemia management**: gentamicin or streptomycin severe, doxycycline and ciprofloxacin milder (relapse awareness), no person to person, tick and animal handling prevention, deer fly and mosquito geographies, post exposure doxycycline for laboratory events. Delayed therapy relapses, drained nodes may suppurate late.
steps.say: Aminoglycoside for severe tularaemia; doxycycline relapses get a second look.

left.title: Therapy
points: Nodes may need drainage despite antibiotics

right.title: Prevention
points: Gloves for game handling, cook game thoroughly

steps.tx: **Pasteurella multocida** is a bipolar gram negative coccobacillus of animal mouths: cat and dog bite cellulitis erupting within hours (faster than staph), deep hand infections, respiratory disease in animal workers, bacteraemia in cirrhosis, penicillin exquisitely susceptible, oxidase positive and indole, grows blood not MacConkey.
steps.say: Cellulitis hours after a cat bite is Pasteurella until excluded; penicillin answers.

left.title: Bite portrait
points: Onset under 24 hours, pain and swelling
Cat bites puncture deep (joint and tendon)

right.title: Therapy anchors
points: Rabies and tetanus assessment parallel (modules meet)

steps.tx: **Bite microbiology beyond Pasteurella**: Capnocytophaga canimorsus (asplenic fulminant sepsis and gangrene), Eikenella corrodens (human bites and clenched fist), anaerobes, Staphylococcus and Streptococcus, rabies risk assessment, each bite history (species, depth, host spleen and immunity) writing prophylaxis.
steps.say: Asplenic plus dog bite plus purpura is Capnocytophaga emergency, not routine cellulitis.

right.title: Human bite cast
points: Hepatitis and HIV assessments low but considered
Surgical exploration of hand bites low threshold

steps.tx: **Bartonella henselae** (cat scratch disease: inoculation papule, regional nodes weeks, neuroretinitis, bacillary angiomatosis in HIV) and **Bartonella quintana** (body louse trench fever, endocarditis, urban homelessness) and bacilliformis (Oroya fever and verruga, sandfly Andes) are fastidious gram negatives diagnosed serology, PCR and special culture.
steps.say: Cat scratch nodes, louse fever, HIV vascular skin lesions: Bartonella by vector and host.

left.title: Henselae
points: Nodes suppurate minority, azithromycin shortens node course

steps.tx: **Culture negative endocarditis zoonoses** reunite here: Bartonella, Brucella, Coxiella (next module), Pasteurella rare, serology and valve PCR pathways, exposure histories (cats, lice, livestock, unpasteurised dairy) part of Duke workup in modern guidelines.
steps.say: Exposure history is a blood culture bottle for fastidious endocarditis.

left.title: Serology first cast
points: Coxiella phase I IgG chronic Q fever

right.title: Valve tissue
points: Prolonged bottle incubation rarely adds now

steps.tx: **Cat scratch node management** tempers intervention: most resolve months, azithromycin shrinks nodes faster, aspiration for painful suppuration, avoid incision drainage (fistulas), biopsy when lymphoma shadows. Bartonella serology IgG supports, PCR node where surgery happens anyway.
steps.say: Aspirate tense cat scratch nodes, do not incise them into fistulas.

left.title: Typical course
points: Papule at scratch in week one
Low fever, self resolution 2 to 4 months

steps.tx: **Zoonotic history system** for examinations closes: animal species, timing, bites versus products versus vectors, occupation, travel, foods unpasteurised, water, caves and parturition products, each mapping a genus. Ten history seconds outrank ten tests in zoonosis triage.
steps.say: Species, vector, product, occupation, timing: five history keys unlock zoonotic benches.

nodes.label: Animal, vector, food and occupation history
